implementation.approach: Add optional logging support to TodoStorage class
implementation.summary: Added logging support to storage.py that outputs DEBUG logs when FLYWHEEL_DEBUG=1 is set. The implementation includes: (1) Module-level logger configuration, (2) _is_debug_enabled() helper function, (3) DEBUG logs for successful load/save operations with file path, todo count, and timing, (4) ERROR logs for failures including JSON decode errors, file size limits, and write failures.

risks: Minimal performance overhead when FLYWHEEL_DEBUG is not set (only a single environment variable check per operation)
